canonicalScan.scope: All endpoint-type/predicate combinations, duplicate triples, self edges and citation presence
canonicalScan.importantException: Cubismo INFLUENCED_BY Paul Cézanne is a reviewed MOVEMENT→ARTIST edge. The seed-only matrix omits this legitimate combination; do not reuse it as a universal rejection rule.
canonicalScan.reasonAccuracyUnavailable: No complete labeled semantic review. A citation and compatible endpoint types do not establish entailment.

evidence: research-ai.service.ts buildInput sends id/key/label, without endpoint/semantic contracts.
validateExtractFindingsOutput checks local endpoint presence, distinctness, allowed relationTypeId and evidence IDs; it does not test predicate meaning against the quote.
The output schema and prompt already allow null for an unsuitable predicate. Unknown IDs become null, not BELONGS_TO_PERIOD.
acceptRelationProposal checks converted private endpoints, then materializes a private relation without semantic predicate validation.
prisma/foundational/validate-catalog.ts has a seed-only endpoint matrix, including WORK→MOVEMENT membership, but it is not a generic proposal semantic gate.
